background_strategy.concept: Warm Artisan Flour & Dual IT/DE Identity Backgrounds
rules: Avoid raw plain white backgrounds. Use #FDFBF7 (crema) for light mode and #120E0D (dark espresso) for dark mode.
Integrate subtle IT/DE ambient background glows using radial gradients: green glow on top-left (#009246/5), red glow on bottom-right (#CE2B37/5), gold glow on top-right (#FFCE00/5).

Sections are distinctly color-block segmented: Ricette section gets warm terracotta subtle tint, Maestro AI section gets dark espresso command center background, Impara section gets sage green tint, PhotoDiagnosi gets tech-dark DE gold theme.
Use subtle grain/paper texture overlay where possible to convey the physical warmth of flour, sourdough, and traditional oven stone.

card_system.concept: 6 Distinct Colored Card Archetypes mapped to App Sections

hero_it_de_fusion.use: Home Hero section, Bi-national announcement banners, Main Call-To-Action

bakery_terracotta.use: Primary recipes, dough calculation CTA, oven controls

bakery_gold.use: Sourdough wake-up guides, timers, alerts, key metrics

sage_organic.use: Bio recipes, fermentations, eco/natural ingredients, beginner steps

de_gold_tactical.use: Capo Laboratorio shift management, temperature calculations, precision tools

it_tricolore_glass.use: Expanded recipe details, Italian tradition cards, ingredient lists

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply exact color palette classes and CSS variables across all views.
Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute.
Maintain responsive layout optimized for mobile viewports (pwa style).
Never compromise readability - contrast between text and background must follow accessibility standards.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_id_requirement: All buttons, inputs, tabs, recipe items, language switchers, and dialog actions MUST retain or add data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use fully transparent header or overlay dropdown backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_library: Use sonner for user feedback toasts.
